logic: Upstream vendor files remain byte-identical. Architect.c, Grid.c, Items.c and Movement.c compile through pinned generated copies replacing only observed traversal/pruning recursion bookkeeping with equivalent bounded DFS frames; all original local decisions and all other upstream units are preserved. Explicit traversal loops call the PXA frontend wall-time scheduling checkpoint; upstream game decisions, arithmetic, RNG calls and update order stay unchanged.
license: AGPL-3.0-or-later (some platform files carry GPL-3.0-or-later headers; combined work follows AGPL)
assets: No optional tile atlas or bundled SDL fonts used. Game text and symbol tables remain upstream. Frontend bitmap uses DejaVu Sans Mono; see FONT-LICENSE.txt.
scope: desktop simulator, 800x552, touch controls; hardware not verified; recording/save files remain volatile
